title: How one ticket is built
desc: The AI builds one attempt. If the locked tests pass, the change goes to the server, which runs the tests again. If not, the AI tries again with what went wrong. After 3 tries, or when stuck, it asks the advisor.

nodes.text:
Run the locked tests
On the AI's own machine

Send to the server
It runs the tests again

Try again
With what went wrong

Ask the advisor
A second AI, or you
